skill.summary: Generate speech from text using Kyutai Pocket TTS - lightweight, CPU-friendly, streaming TTS with voice cloning. English only. ~6x real-time on M4 MacBook Air.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Pocket-TTS skill.
- Generate English speech from text using Kyutai Pocket TTS, optimized for CPU-only use with no GPU required.
- Supports voice cloning from 3–10 second audio samples and streaming, low-latency audio generation (~6x real-time on modern CPUs).
- Provides both CLI and Python API interfaces for text-to-speech generation and voice management.
- Outputs high-quality 24kHz mono WAV files.
- Includes guidance for installation, usage, voice cloning, and performance optimization.
